notes: Sony's own pro.sony product/spec pages and B&H returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch, so specs were corroborated across three independent secondary sources: B&H (bhphotovideo.com) and Markertek retailer spec tables, plus excerpts of Sony's own MCX-500 Operating Instructions Manual (via manualslib.com). All three agree on connector counts/types. SDI is specified only as "3G/HD/SD-SDI, 75-ohm, SMPTE 292M/259M/424M/425M" without Sony stating a single definitive top grade per port on all four sources; graded as sdi-3g (the switcher's stated maximum) per B&H/Markertek "4x 3G-SDI inputs" language — note the single SDI/BNC program output is described in the manual/Markertek as "HD SDI, 1.5Gbps, SMPTE 292M" (HD-SDI only, not 3G), so it is graded sdi-hd rather than sdi-3g. HDMI inputs/outputs are specified only by supported resolutions (up to 1920x1080i/p) with no HDMI version number stated by any source, so grade is omitted (not inferable to a specific hdmi-1.x/2.x tier). Ethernet ports are listed as "100BASE-TX/1000BASE-T" (Markertek) so graded eth-1g; the manual names them STREAMING (network/live streaming uplink) and PC UI (remote control from PC/tablet) — both are RJ-45, direction set bidirectional per instructions. USB is a Mini-B port used for firmware update via a supplied USB cable (rear MAIN port; a second SUB port exists on the side panel per manual excerpts but could not be independently confirmed on B&H/Markertek, so it is omitted here to avoid an unconfirmed port). Power is DC IN 12V via an external supplied AC adapter (barrel connector) — no NEMA/IEC mains inlet on the chassis itself. RS-232C OPTION connector is for a wired Remote Commander accessory. Tally is a female 9-pin D-sub (non-listed connector family; omitted from ports list since no close connector id exists in the allowed set and it is a low-signal control interface, not core AV signal path). RGB Title/DSK input and RGB output use 15-pin D-Sub (Shrink) connectors — mapped to "vga" as the closest connector id in the allowed list, though Sony documentation calls it "RGB," not "VGA." Region variants (e.g. MCX-500 vs regional SKUs) were not checked; NTSC/PAL and 50/60Hz global switch capability suggests no region-locked hardware variant.

ports.name: TITLE (RGB/DSK) IN
ports.note: 15-pin D-Sub Shrink RGB input for external computer title/DSK overlay, up to 1600x1200; closest allowed connector id to Sony's proprietary RGB D-Sub Shrink 15-pin.

ports.name: RGB OUT
ports.note: 15-pin D-Sub Shrink RGB output, up to 1600x1200; closest allowed connector id.

ports.name: STREAMING
ports.note: Network connector for live streaming/Ethernet uplink.

ports.name: PC UI
ports.note: Network connector for remote control from PC/Mac/tablet UI.

ports.name: USB (MAIN)
ports.note: Mini-B USB port used with supplied USB cable, primarily for firmware update; closest allowed connector id to USB Mini-B.

ports.name: Memory Card Slot (SD/SDHC/SDXC)
ports.note: Not an actual USB port — SD/SDHC/SDXC card slot for onboard recording; no matching connector id exists in the allowed list, included as closest fallback. Treat as non-cable storage media slot rather than a cable I/O port.

ports.name: DC IN
ports.note: DC IN 12V connector, powered via supplied external AC adaptor (no internal mains IEC/NEMA inlet).
